name: Z-Image Turbo
format: ComfyUI API-format prompt graph: {node_id: {class_type, inputs}}. POST it as the `prompt` field of POST /prompt.
source: Comfy-Org's template image_z_image_turbo as an API graph; the graph that painted the website example desert-glass on the user's Mac (.scratch/examples/graphs/desert-glass.request.json), with placeholders. The default: AutoPaper uses it when no model is chosen.

output.history_path: outputs.10.images[0] -> {filename, subfolder, type}; fetch with GET /view?filename=&subfolder=&type=

notes: Placeholders are JSON strings ("{{width}}") so the file stays valid JSON. Replace the whole string value: width, height and seed with JSON numbers, prompt with a JSON-escaped string.
There is no negative prompt: the negative conditioning is ConditioningZeroOut of the positive, as in the official template (cfg 1.0). Do not put negated phrases in the positive prompt.
Fixed sampling (official template image_z_image_turbo): steps 8, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 3.0.

Width and height must be multiples of 16. AutoPaper asks for at most 2048 a side and 2,965,760 pixels (core/src/providers/comfyui.rs MODEL_LIMITS): on Apple silicon VAEDecode fails with 'MPSGraph does not support tensor dims larger than INT_MAX' once (W/8)*(H/8) passes 46,340 (2048x1456 failed, 2048x1440 worked; 2544x1632 failed once and passed once, depending on ComfyUI's free-memory slicing).
filename_prefix 'autopaper/wallpaper' makes ComfyUI write into output/autopaper/ (the history entry reports subfolder 'autopaper').

measured_seconds.1920x1088_warm: 42-65 on M5 Max (first run with model load: 74)
measured_seconds.2048x1152_warm: 60.5 (whole run through the engine, M5 Max, 2026-10-06)
measured_seconds.2032x1312_warm: 69.2 (ComfyUI time; 72.0 s through the engine, M5 Max, 2026-10-06)
